body:
I've found the error which was in the incorrect message being displayed.
However the validation of the mapping is correct so while the message is incorrect (by repeating the index name twice) .
The mapping that you posted are quite big however I've spotted a couple of differences between them - for example:
`news-20180614` has an extra field (`language`) versus `news-20180613`.

In the future, we'll work on improving the message (to indicate where the difference occurs) and eventually improve the mapping merging itself (though that by itself has some other implications since an extra field in an index might affect aggregations and such in indices that do not have it).
